# Toon posterize

Flattens brightness into a few bands while keeping each color’s hue, and darkens edges, for a cartoon look on any image.

<EffectDemo effect="posterize" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { posterize } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/posterize';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(posterize({ preset: 'cartoon' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.bands = 4`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type   | Default | Range  | Description                  |
| ------------ | ------ | ------- | ------ | ---------------------------- |
| `bands`      | number | `4`     | 2 – 12 | Number of brightness bands.  |
| `saturation` | number | `1.2`   | 0 – 2  | Color strength of the bands. |
| `edges`      | number | `0.7`   | 0 – 1  | How dark edges become.       |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                    |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `cartoon` | `bands: 3`, `saturation: 1.4`, `edges: 0.9` |
| `poster`  | `bands: 5`, `edges: 0`                      |
| `comic`   | `bands: 4`, `edges: 1`                      |
| `soft`    | `bands: 8`, `edges: 0.3`, `saturation: 1`   |

Apply one with `posterize({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 18.2 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/posterize`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Edge detect (Sobel, Canny)](./edges) — Finds edges in the image itself (not the 3D geometry, unlike outline): Sobel gradients of brightness, optionally thinned to one-pixel lines as Canny does, over the image, on paper, or glowing on black.
- [Kuwahara (painterly)](./kuwahara) — An edge-preserving smoothing filter that turns detail into flat, brushy patches, like an oil painting: each pixel takes the calmest neighboring region’s average.
- [Outline](./outline) — Draws lines where the depth or the surface direction changes, for a toon or technical-drawing look.
